static-laya.limits: Public authored synthetic cases. Translations and repeats share scenario clusters. Bootstrap intervals describe this small corpus, not deployment reliability.

static-laya-multilingual.limits: Public authored synthetic cases. Translations and repeats share scenario clusters. Bootstrap intervals describe this small corpus, not deployment reliability.

typed-laya.limits: Small authored English public regression set. Score correctness uses absolute error <=0.5 on a zero-based 0..4 rubric; noul uses >=0.5. Clean errors are excluded from attack denominators. No population-level robustness claim.
